contradicting_evidence: The breadth and capitalization-proxy snapshot is sufficiently strong that uninterrupted upside is a credible alternative to a choppy recovery/retest path.
Latest negative ETF flows and short-window liquidity contraction could produce a more directional decline rather than two-sided trading.
The supplied data lack the repeated observations needed to demonstrate that alternating recovery attempts and retests are already an established pattern.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Recovery attempts and downside retests both remain credible, without a reliable net directional edge. Current ETH-relative and cross-cap strength can support further gains, but those gains remain vulnerable unless participation persists and settled demand improves. No fixed ordering or timing of these moves is supported.
falsification_conditions: Persistent BTC and ETH gains, strengthening ETH/BTC and sustained broad participation establish a coherent upward path, especially if settled flows improve.
Persistent joint price weakness, renewed ETH/BTC deterioration and shrinking breadth establish a coherent downward path.
Either outcome must persist beyond a single candle or flow observation to displace the mixed outlook.
missing_evidence: Updated final ETF sessions after October 14 and evidence of a broader flow trend.
Repeated cross-cap breadth observations and canonical breadth confirmation.
A sustained spot-price and open-interest sequence to distinguish healthy continuation from leveraged fragility.
supporting_evidence: Strong current breadth and positive median returns across observed capitalization buckets support recovery attempts.
Final October 14 ETF flows were negative $261.4 million for BTC and negative $129.5 million for ETH, countering confidence in sustained demand.
Stablecoin supply fell about 0.60% over seven days, while its approximately 0.59% monthly increase has no established deployment confirmation.
BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC remain below the supplied W41 closing references despite their recent positive short-window performance.
